systems.platform: AI-powered system built by LADS Africa, a Harare Institute of Technology start-up
systems.owner: Government of Zimbabwe (launched by the President with the Ministry of Local Government and Public Works present)
systems.tiers: National, launched 18 June 2026: citizens give feedback on and score the performance of local authorities, urban and rural

note: A platform for residents to rate local authorities; nothing on whether council offices are connected or work over a connection.
